Aurora Cannabis Rejects Curaleaf's Hostile Takeover Bid

Aurora Cannabis has formally urged its shareholders to reject a hostile takeover offer from Curaleaf, deeming the bid inadequate. The company stated its position in response to the unsolicited proposal from Curaleaf. Aurora Cannabis is advising its shareholders to take no action regarding the offer. The specific financial terms of Curaleaf's offer were not detailed in the coverage.
